resolution.note: arm A and arm C share sessionArgv (session-args.ts); test asserts argv differs only in the arm settings file

title: Replay arms A and C run the same model, budget and permission mode
body:
evals/replay/arm-c.ts runs arm C with --model sonnet, a 5 USD budget and KRN's headless lane arguments, while arm A (live.ts) runs claude defaults with bypassPermissions and no budget. Rows of the two arms differ in model and budget, not only in KRN.
Outcome: arms A and C share one session argument builder (model, budget, permission mode, denied tools); only the KRN adoption differs.
Proof: a unit test asserts the argv of an arm-A and an arm-C session differ only in the KRN-owned parts.
